//: Schools recorded by hand, for places the databases do not reach.
//why: Two databases between them still miss whole countries. This is the third route: add a school by name from research, an association's member list, or a colleague, and it is verified and merged like any other.
//verification: An entry without a website goes through the same discovery and page check as a guessed one, and is dropped if the school cannot be confirmed. A name without a verified school behind it is a rumour, and a rumour in the sheet is indistinguishable from a fact. Once resolved, the website is written back here so the search runs once.
//fields: name and country are required. city, website, via and note are optional. Set "on": false to keep an entry on file without using it.
//adding: npm run known -- checks every entry and reports which could not be verified.
//sources-worth-mining: EARCOS (East Asia), FOBISIA (British schools in Asia), ISAT (Thailand), ACAMIS (China), TAISI (India), AISA (Africa), and the accreditation bodies CIS, COBIS, NEASC and WASC — all publish member lists covering the configured countries.
